title: Normative support for user input
change_reason: Original source-grounded pilot draft; human review pending.
observation: SC 3.3.2 requires labels or instructions for content where people enter information.
interpretation: Evaluate whether a person can identify what each requested entry requires.
scope: WCAG 2.2 SC 3.3.2, Level A; web content requiring user input.
method: Manual inspection of the linked official document and the named section; original paraphrase, no empirical user test.
limitations: This requirement is distinct from programmatic naming.
No universal field layout or wording is prescribed by this record.
